Sarah K: Heads-up — NebulaPay sent over a SIG/CAIQ bundle (90 questions). Sales intake form + uploaded PDF in the deal folder: https://redwood.internal/deals/nebulapay/sig.pdf :eyes:
Mike V: thanks. can you drop the top 5 friction points? tagging sec queue. RISK-4921 created by assign-bot.
assign-bot: Ticket RISK-4921 created and assigned to security triage. Owner: Mike V. SLA: 3 business days.
Sarah K: quick summary: they care most about KMS/HSM, tenant isolation for multi-tenant workloads, data residency (EU), vendor subprocessors, and code review for our telemetry. also a couple of legal/flow questions about data deletion timelines.
Jordan P: do we have an existing one-pager on KMS options (managed vs customer keys)? might speed answers.
Lucy H: we do — filing it now. link: https://redwood.internal/knowledge/kms-comparison. I'll paste the short answers below.
Lucy H: ```
Q12: Do you support customer-managed keys (CMK)?
A: Yes. Hosted and Private deployments support CMK via KMS (AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure Key Vault) and HSM integrations for Private. Key rotation and access logs are supported.
Q25: Data residency controls?
A: Customers can pin region and restrict model serving to specific cloud regions (EU/US) in Private and Dedicated. Hosted API offers region selection and contractual terms for EU-only processing on enterprise plans.
```
Mike V: good. two follow-ups I need engineering on:
- evidence for our telemetry data flow (what telemetry we collect, retention, PII filtering).
- a statement re: subprocessor list and how we notify customers of changes (legal wants process doc).
Sarah K: legal asked also whether we will accept a vendor addendum for NebulaPay (they're requesting a 30-day data deletion SLA in the DPA).
Jordan P: engineering can provide the telemetry flow diagram + retention numbers. Lucy, can you get those assets attached to RISK-4921?
Lucy H: on it. ETA EOD today for the diagram, tomorrow for log retention table.
Mike V: actionable plan: I’ll draft responses for the first pass (KMS, residency, basics). Jordan/Lucy — please add technical attachments to the ticket. Sarah — can you confirm NebulaPay's contract contact so legal can route the DPA question?
Sarah K: contact is emma@nebulapay.com. cc'ing legal in the channel now.
Sarah K: @legal-team FYI — NebulaPay wants 30-day deletion commitment in the DPA, asking for confirmation before next week.
Mike V: noted. if legal needs a tech statement on deletion time we can propose our standard timeline and note exceptions for forensics.
assign-bot: Reminder scheduled: RISK-4921 triage meeting tomorrow 11:00am PT with Mike V, Jordan P, Lucy H, Sarah K. Join link: https://meet.link/4921
Sarah K: perfect. I’ll prep the customer-facing email draft and ping once we have the first-pass answers.
Jordan P: one more thing — is there any expected cost/price impact if we enable CMK for them? Sarah, they asked whether CMK adds to recurring fees.
Sarah K: they asked pricing earlier — I told them CMK may incur a one-time setup fee + small monthly key store fee. need confirmation from finance.
Mike V: I'll loop in finance after we have the tech attachments; want to avoid giving an exact $ until finance confirms.
Lucy H: attachments uploaded to RISK-4921: telemetry-diagram.pdf, log-retention.csv, kms-config-summary.md.
Sarah K: thanks team. next steps: security drafts answers by EOD tomorrow, legal reviews DPA clause, finance confirms CMK pricing, then sales sends back to NebulaPay.
Mike V: marking status: in-progress. will update ticket when draft is posted. :thumbsup:
Sarah K: closing the loop here — will update the channel once customer reply received. cheers.
